text: Doing shrugs for your traps... but your upper back still looks flat?
Your traps have three parts. The top part shrugs. The middle and lower parts pull your shoulder blades back and down.
Shrugs train the top. Face pulls hit the middle traps and rear delts. Y raises train the lower traps. And wide-grip rows build the whole mid back.
Shrugs alone only train the top part. Add one pulling-back move.
Next up: the squat. Save this.
